definitions.explanation: The opening into which a plug, card, or connector is inserted. Used for electrical outlets, headphone jacks, USB ports, card slots, and similar receptacles.

examples.japanese: {差|さ}し{込|こ}み{口|ぐち}が{見|み}つからない。
USBの{差|さ}し{込|こ}み{口|ぐち}はパソコンの{裏側|うらがわ}にある。
examples.english: The USB port is on the back of the computer.

examples.japanese: この{部屋|へや}は{差|さ}し{込|こ}み{口|ぐち}が{少|すく}ないので、{延長|えんちょう}コードが{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: This room has few outlets, so an extension cord is necessary.

notes:
{差|さ}し{込|こ}む (to insert, to plug in) + {口|ぐち} (opening). A plain, descriptive word for any hole something plugs into, so it works where a more specific term is unknown or unnecessary.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電源|でんげん}の{差|さ}し{込|こ}み{口|ぐち}: power outlet
- イヤホンの{差|さ}し{込|こ}み{口|ぐち}: headphone jack
- {差|さ}し{込|こ}み{口|ぐち}に{差|さ}し{込|こ}む: to plug into the socket

SIMILAR WORDS:
- コンセント: electrical outlet — the everyday word for a wall socket specifically
- ポート: port — used for computer connectors in technical writing
- {差|さ}し{込|こ}みプラグ: plug — the part that goes in, not the opening
